title: Mexican TikTok influencer Cesar Gastelum is shot dead during a livestream in Culiacan Sinaloa
summary_full: Cesar Gastelum, a popular TikTok comedian from Mexico, was tragically killed during a livestream in Culiacan. While entertaining his audience, gunfire erupted as two individuals on a motorcycle targeted him. The shocking footage appears to show the assailant shooting. Known for his comedic prowess and a following of nearly 600,000, Gastelum’s death highlights the risks faced by online personalities.
